title: Come, God Creator, Holy Ghost
description: Come, God Creator, Holy Ghost in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 7 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Charlemagne and Rhabanus Maurus and Gregory the Great and Ambrose of Milan. The English translation is by Martin Luther and Leonard Woolsey Bacon (1524). The tune, KOMM, GOTT SCHOEPFER HEILIGER GEIST, is Traditional Latin. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Come, God Cre-a-tor, Ho-ly Ghost, And vis-it Thou these souls of men; Fill them with gra-ces, as Thou dost, Thy crea-tures make pure_ a-gain.

lines: Come, God Creator, Holy Ghost,
And visit Thou these souls of men;
Fill them with graces, as Thou dost,
Thy creatures make pure again.
For Comforter Thy name we call.
Sweet gift of God most high above,
A holy unction to us all
O Fount of life, Fire of love.
Our minds illumine and refresh,
Deep in our hearts let love burn bright;
Thou know'st the weakness of our flesh;
And strengthen us with Thy might.
Thou with Thy wondrous sev'nfold gifts
The finger art of God's right hand;
The Father's Word Thou sendest swift
On tongues of fire to each land.
Drive far from us our wily foe;
Grant us Thy blesséd peace within,
That in Thy footsteps we may go,
And shun the dark ways of sin.
Teach us the Father well to know,
Likewise His only Son our Lord,
Thyself to us believing show,
Spirit of both, aye adored
Praise to the Father, and the Son
Who from the dead is risen again;
Praise to the Comforter be done
Both now and ever. Amen.
